purpose: Developer-only QA matrix for Seat Planner Codex handoffs.

categories.name: Auth and routing
categories.goal: Auth gates and route responsibilities remain unchanged.
checks: /admin requires authenticated admin access.
/admin/management requires authenticated admin access.
Viewer and admin routes do not share admin-only UI state.

categories.name: Viewer/public map
categories.goal: Viewer route shows the published map and viewer-only copy.
checks: Viewer route reads published seats only.
Viewer route does not show admin controls.
Viewer inspector copy says: "Select a seat to view assignment details."

categories.name: Admin draft map
categories.goal: Admin map continues to edit draft seats only.
checks: Admin route reads draft seats.
Assignment controls remain scoped to admin routes.
Admin assignment copy does not appear on the viewer route.

categories.name: Management page
categories.goal: Admin management remains protected and operational.
checks: Management page requires auth.
Management workflows do not reference removed legacy tables.
CSV/data-quality behavior remains covered by existing tests.

categories.name: Publish workflow
categories.goal: Publishing preserves draft/published separation and audit behavior.
checks: Publishing draft data updates published map intentionally.
Publishing does not collapse draft and published seat behavior.
Publish history behavior remains covered by existing tests.

categories.name: Assignment/vacate workflow
categories.goal: Assignment and vacate interactions remain reversible and safe.
checks: Vacate confirmation preserves assignment when cancelled.
Protected original seats cannot be directly deleted.
Custom seat removal remains separate from protected seat behavior.

categories.name: Search/filter behavior
categories.goal: Search and filter controls continue to find expected assignments.
checks: Search finds expected assigned users.
Filters do not hide valid assigned-seat matches unexpectedly.
Viewer search remains simpler than admin workflows.

categories.name: Mobile smoke test
categories.goal: Mobile map remains usable, readable, and non-overlapping.
checks: Seat markers remain readable on mobile viewport.
Inspector and map controls do not overlap incoherently.
Core viewer/admin map workflows remain usable on mobile.

categories.name: Supabase/runtime table access
categories.goal: Runtime code references current Supabase objects only.
checks: No removed legacy tables are referenced by app/runtime code.
No schema drift is introduced by tooling-only changes.
RLS and server-side admin boundaries remain the security boundary.

categories.name: Build/lint/typecheck/tests
categories.goal: Standard verification remains green before handoff.
checks: npm test passes.
npm run typecheck passes.
npm run lint passes.
npm run build passes.
